description: Look up a currency by its ISO 4217 alphabetic or numeric code: the official English name, minor-unit exponent, fund flag, the smallest cash denomination where it differs from the minor unit, the territories that use it, and historic codes on request. Returns the correct rounding increment for cash amounts, which is what a caller needs to render or settle a price. This route returns currency facts only and never an exchange rate. Price: $0.05 per successful call, paid over x402 (USDC on Base).

code.description: ISO 4217 alpha-3 or 3-digit numeric code. Accepted: a 3-letter alphabetic or 3-digit numeric ISO 4217 code.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2; returns the currencies in use there. Accepted: an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code.

include.description: Comma-separated: territories, historic. Default none. Accepted: comma-separated subset of territories, historic.

name: ref_currency
title: Currency record (ISO 4217 codes, names and minor units; CLDR cash rounding)
